ingredients.name: Hyaluronic Acid (Multi-Molecular)
ingredients.benefits: Deep multi-layer surface hydration, plumps appearance of dehydration lines, softens texture.
ingredients.contraindications: Apply to damp skin; lock with an emollient in dry climates.

ingredients.name: Niacinamide (Vitamin B3 2-5%)
ingredients.benefits: Visibly refines pore appearance, harmonizes surface sebum, balances skin tone, supports barrier.
ingredients.contraindications: Avoid pairing at exact same step with high-strength pure L-Ascorbic Acid if prone to flushing.

ingredients.name: Ceramide Complex (NP, AP, EOP)
ingredients.benefits: Fortifies moisture barrier, visibly reduces flaky texture, protects against environmental stressors.
ingredients.contraindications: Suitable for daily morning and evening use.

ingredients.name: Centella Asiatica (Cica / Madecassoside)
ingredients.benefits: Visibly calms superficial facial redness, comfort-enhancing botanical extract, reinforces moisture balance.
ingredients.contraindications: Very gentle; suitable for daily soothing routines.

ingredients.name: Rosemary Leaf Extract & Peptide Complex
ingredients.benefits: Botanical extract renowned for invigorating scalp circulation, supporting the visual appearance of follicle density and root resilience.
ingredients.contraindications: Massage into scalp nightly; cosmetic non-medical formulation.

ingredients.name: Bio-Fermented Hydrolyzed Plant Keratin
ingredients.benefits: Penetrates visual gaps in the hair cuticle, sealing in moisture, taming flyaways, and dramatically reducing frizz.
ingredients.contraindications: Use 1-2 times weekly in rinse-off masks.

ingredients.name: Cold-Pressed Organic Argan Oil
ingredients.benefits: Rich in oleic and linoleic essential fatty acids; imparts reflective mirror-like gloss and protects hair fiber from environmental heat.
ingredients.contraindications: Apply 1-2 drops to mid-lengths and ends.

products.name: Bio-Adaptive Phyto Cleansing Milk
products.howToUse: Massage 1-2 pumps onto damp skin morning and night.

products.name: Bio-Regenerative Barrier Cream
products.howToUse: Warm between fingertips and smooth across face and neck.

products.name: Follicle-Bio Rosemary & Caffeine Scalp Tonic
products.howToUse: Apply 1 dropper-full directly onto clean scalp in sectioned partings; massage for 2 minutes before bed.

products.name: Phyto-Keratin Deep Bond Recovery Hair Mask
products.howToUse: Work generously through wet mid-lengths to ends after shampooing. Leave for 7-10 minutes before rinsing.

products.name: Mirror-Gloss Botanical Silk Argan Finishing Drops
products.howToUse: Smooth 1-2 drops through damp or dry ends to eliminate frizz and impart high-gloss sheen.
